description:
Permit the reviewed esbuild installer through npm's dependency script policy so a clean web install completes without blocked-script warnings.

## Background

On Node 26 with npm 12, a clean Linux install reports that esbuild's postinstall is blocked. The pinned esbuild 0.25.12 installer selects a platform binary, verifies its version, and can use npm or HTTPS fallback when the optional platform package is missing. Node 20 remains the CI baseline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A clean Linux npm 12 install allows only the reviewed esbuild 0.25.12 installer through the project policy and emits no blocked-script warning for it; unrelated dependency scripts are not broadly approved.
- [hard] REQ-02: A real clean offline install exercises that policy and the web checks pass; Node 20 and its bundled npm remain compatible with the project manifest.
- [hard] REQ-03: No warning threshold, logging suppression, global npm setting, or unrelated installer approval is introduced.
title: Declare the reviewed web build installer policy
